subject: Zoning Updates Project Consultant RFP
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed a draft Request for Proposals to hire a zoning consultant for the next multi-year phase of Medford's Zoning Updates Project. The committee voted to advance the procurement process with revisions addressing design standards, meeting scheduling, and finalist review procedures.

items.title: Item 24033 - Zoning Updates Project RFP
items.summary: Approved a motion authorizing Planning Director Alicia Hunt to advance the Request for Proposals for a zoning consultant, incorporating council feedback on design standards, project feasibility, and reviewing finalists prior to selection. The committee and staff discussed meeting counts, consultant qualifications, and coordination with a separate communications consultant.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents spoke regarding the practical differences between rigid design standards and flexible design guidelines, recommended flexibility in consultant meeting schedules, and supported continued joint meetings between the City Council and the Community Development Board.
